_doc: Profiles for scripts/havok/gr2_lint.py. 'references' = numbers MEASURED on vanilla models (python scripts/havok/gr2_lint.py --measure-reference <vanilla.gr2>, files extracted to a scratchpad, never into the repo); never on a pilot or on the model under test.
'profiles' = one building each: its files, the reference it must match, and its own design facts (platform height, props on the fixed base bone) with the reason for each tolerance.

Frames: 'raw' = the gr2 file's own coordinates (y up). 'display' = (-x_raw, -z_raw, y_raw): +X right, +Y back, +Z up, as rotate_gr2.py documents. Quadrants are display-frame, relative to the footprint (bbox) centre.

tools._doc: gr2_to_raw.py (headless Granny DLL read under Wine/WSL). Override: env GR2_LINT_TOOLS or config/tool-paths.local.json tools.gr2_to_raw_dir. Missing -> the dll_read check is SKIP, never PASS.

china_tc_age2.layout_words: tower (flag mast) back-right, open courtyard front-left

japan_tc_age1.source: vanilla japan_towncenter_age1.gr2 + _damaged.gr2, measured 2026-09-29 (second opinion on the conventions)

korean_tc._doc: Korean Town Center (donor graph: the China TC age 2 damaged model). Specimens: tests/test_gr2_lint.py.

limits._doc: damaged meshes are drawn with 16-bit indices (2026-09-29: one 102,527-vertex mesh wrapped into building-high sheets)

orientation._doc: from china_tc_age2 (Japan TC age 1 agrees). Courtyard = the quadrant with the least up-facing area above roof_height_m. A 90-degree turn or an x/z mirror moves the mast to another quadrant.

handedness._doc: area share of UV charts with the expected handedness; vanilla 0.70-0.95, a mirrored model ~0.05-0.30. It catches the diagonal mirror the quadrants cannot see. name_board (optional): {"stage": "intact", "mesh": "<mesh name>", "triangles": [ids], "expect_sign": 1} - fill the ids once the owner confirms the board reads correctly in game.

attach._doc: vanilla China TC convention (the donor): civ flag on the mast axis (vanilla 1.2 cm off), 1.3788 m below the tip, garrison flag 1.106 m below it; hitpoint bar at the fixed vanilla point (China and Japan identical). The pilot flag hung 15.5 cm beside its pole.

damaged._frame_doc: the damaged model sits in the intact's frame: vanilla China bbox and tip identical, attach bones identical, the damaged pole measures 0.146 m (Japan 0.058) from the intact pole - a turn or mirror moves it by > 3 m.

base_allowed_boxes._doc: raw-frame [min, max] boxes of the props the design keeps on the fixed base bone (Destruction_S18k HANDOFF: 'notice board + jar cluster on the fixed base bone'). Everything else on the base above the platform is a defect (window panels left behind when the pieces fall).

damaged._base_doc: platform = the Korean stone platform, top 0.55 m in the design (vanilla China's platform reaches 2.12 m). The notice-board foot box is below the platform height anyway; kept for clarity.

hkt._doc: vanilla China: Havok body translation = 1.0222 x (z, y, x) of the GR2 bone world position, median 1.07 cm, every body paired. Render vertices vs their own piece's convex hull: vanilla China farthest 0.066 m outside, 0.05% of 45,915 vertices beyond 5 cm; a piece bound to the wrong bone or frame sits metres away.
